heroHeadline: Government Crisis and Oil Shock: Ali al-Zaidi Named PM-Designate as Hormuz Blockade Cuts Iraq Oil Output 66%
heroSubtitle: Ali al-Zaidi (39), a Dhi Qar businessman, was named Iraq's prime minister-designate on April 27, advancing a 14-pillar governance program as Kurdistan President Barzani pressured Baghdad on salary arrears. The Hormuz crisis has slashed oil production to ~1.5M bpd from 4.4M pre-war; Iraq broke ground on the $1.5B Basra-Haditha pipeline for export diversification. US Treasury sanctioned Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister on May 7 for facilitating Iranian sanctions evasion.
